title: Career roadmap · Research Chair
summary: Build a recognised body of high-impact research into an independent research-chair career through sustained scholarship, major grants, research leadership, doctoral supervision and institutional or industry partnerships.

facts.Current degree: D.Sc / D.Litt / DBA / Post-Doctoral & Industry-Sponsored Doctorates
facts.Timeline assumption: This is an advanced academic pathway. A higher doctorate such as D.Sc./D.Litt. is normally evidence of substantial scholarly contribution rather than a substitute for the research record required for a chair appointment. Exact higher-doctorate and Research Chair rules vary by university and discipline, so institution-specific regulations and vacancy notices remain controlling.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Senior researcher, postdoctoral researcher, faculty researcher, principal investigator or research-programme lead.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Establish a distinctive research programme, strong publication record, competitive funding and doctoral-supervision profile.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Build toward Professor, Research Professor, Endowed Chair or institutional research-leadership roles.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Lead a major research centre or chair with international collaborations, large programmes and measurable scholarly/public impact.

rows.text: Produce a 5-year research strategy with 3–5 flagship questions
Submit two strong manuscripts to appropriate peer-reviewed journals
Establish one documented cross-institutional research collaboration
Supervise/mentor research work where institutionally permitted
Lead one research seminar or thematic research programme
Deliver an international conference presentation or collaborative publication
Document one real-world research impact case
Assemble publications, grants, citations, supervision and impact evidence
Produce a funded multi-year research programme with defined outcomes

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: The goal is to become recognised for a research programme, not simply for holding a higher doctorate. Build a team, attract funding, supervise researchers, develop international collaborations and maintain a clear record of scholarly and practical impact.
At this career stage, conventional internships are generally inappropriate. Target research appointments, visiting-scholar positions, fellowships, sponsored projects and research-chair programmes.

blocks.label: Live-posting note
blocks.text: Research Chair appointments are often institution-specific and may be endowed, sponsored or created around a research theme. Check the exact appointment criteria rather than treating the higher doctorate as automatic qualification.

A D.Sc./D.Litt. holder normally should not pursue another general postgraduate degree. The relevant progression is research leadership, chair appointments, visiting professorships and major funded programmes.

items.text: Doctoral training and academic capacity building

blocks.text: A durable Research Chair profile rests on a coherent body of work, not the accumulation of degrees. Maintain a visible research agenda, attract competitive funding, supervise strong researchers, build international partnerships and demonstrate impact beyond publications. The ultimate objective is to create a research programme that continues to produce important work independently of any single project or appointment.
